Ritual 01

Sunday Reset

The ritual of closing one week and opening the next. The Sunday Reset Digital Planner is a calm 2027 planner shaped like a little book — year, twelve months with real calendars, weeks and days, plus goals, self-care and money pages — all in one softly organised system for your iPad or tablet.

What's inside
  • Year, month, week & day spreads
  • Goals, vision & money-tracking pages
  • Self-care, mood & habit trackers
  • Hyperlinked navigation between sections

How it works

Open it. Write on it. Make it yours.

Our planners are digital PDFs you fill in on your tablet or computer. Here is how they work and what you can do on every page.

01

Download your PDF

Right after your purchase you get your planner as a PDF, ready to use.

02

Open it in your app

GoodNotes, Notability, Noteshelf or any PDF annotation app on your tablet or computer.

03

Write, draw, decorate

Use your Apple Pencil or stylus, type in text boxes, highlight and add stickers.

04

Reuse it again and again

Duplicate pages, clear them and start fresh every week, month or year.

Help

Frequently asked questions

When does Soft Rituals open?

We're opening soon. Join the waitlist and we'll email you the day we launch.

What do I get for joining the waitlist?

20% off your first planner on launch day, sent to you by email. Joining is free and you don't pay anything now.

Do I need to enter card details to join?

No. We only ask for your name and email.

What is a digital planner?

A PDF planner you open on your tablet or laptop and write on with an Apple Pencil, a stylus or your finger, using an app like GoodNotes or Notability.

Which apps and devices will work?

GoodNotes, Notability and any PDF annotation app, on iPad, Android tablets and computers. The Money Dashboard is an Excel file that also opens in Google Sheets.

Can I print the planners?

They are designed for screens, but you can print pages for your own personal use.

How will I receive my planner?

Digital planners are delivered as an instant download once we open.

Can I ask for a custom planner?

Yes. Tell us your idea in the Custom planners section and we'll reply by email with a quote.

Will there be printed planners and journals?

It's an idea for the future. We're not working on physical products yet, but waitlist members will hear first.

What about refunds?

Our full refund policy will be published before we open. Questions? Write to softrituals.shop@gmail.com.

How do I leave the waitlist or delete my data?

Use the unsubscribe link in any of our emails, or write to softrituals.shop@gmail.com and we'll remove your details.
